svg.title: Seven-day forecast error by horizon
svg.desc: A generated three-panel chart for twelve rolling forecast origins. The top panel compares actual help requests with recursive regression and seasonal-naive predictions over the final twelve weeks. The lower panels show mean absolute error by forecast day and overall.
